### Deals and Pipelines {slug: crm/deals}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Deals".
- Board with one column per stage. Computer only; a phone shows "Open this on a computer".
- "View settings": "Layout" ("Board" or "Table"), "Group by" (default "Stage"), "Show field labels", "Hide empty fields", "Compact cards".
- The board shows one pipeline (pipeline picker). Dragging stays inside a deal's own pipeline; use "Move pipeline" in "Table".
- New pipeline: picker > "New pipeline" > "Pipeline Template" or "Custom Pipeline", "Pipeline Name", "Pipeline Stages" (unique names, optional probability 0 to 100, tick "Won"/"Lost", "Add Stage") > "Create Pipeline". Needs at least one "Won" and one "Lost"; the last of either can't be removed.
- "Edit pipeline" > "Update Pipeline". "Delete pipeline" is permanent and removes its stages; empty stages holding deals first.
- "New deal" or "+" on a column > "Create Deal". Required: "Deal Name", "Pipeline", "Stage". Optional: "Amount", "Currency" (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD), "Value period" ("One-off", "Monthly", "Annual"), "Description", "Win Probability (%)", "Source", "Owner", "Contacts", "Companies".
- Cold Email Agent or AI SDR can create a deal from an interested reply or booked meeting, not opens or clicks. Check it. If missing, use "New deal" or contact support with campaign name and reply date.
- Move: drag; card three dots > "Move to stage"; in the deal, "Advance stage". It never moves to Won or Lost itself; then "Mark won"/"Mark lost" appear. Won/Lost deals aren't locked.
- "Table": tick deals > "Change owner", "Change stage", "Move pipeline", "Update tags". "More": "Import deals", "Export this view".
- Delete: card three dots > "Delete" > confirm. Permanent; people and conversations stay.
- No stage to pick: create a pipeline first.

### Connect Your Custom Domain {slug: ai-website-builder/connect-custom-domain}
Get here: "Sites" > "Websites", open the website, open the domain setup flow, choose "I already own a domain".
- Copy the DNS records shown in the app (the source of truth) into wherever your DNS is managed. That may not be your registrar. If records can't be edited or do nothing, check the nameservers.
- Steps: enter the domain exactly as visitors should type it (example.com, www.example.com or a subdomain). Copy Type, Name/Host and Value exactly. Add them at your DNS provider. Wait for the status to update. DNS changes aren't instant.
- Subdomain: enter the full subdomain in the app, then add records in the main domain's DNS. Host is usually the short name (keepersolutions for keepersolutions.northstaros.com) unless the app gives another. No separate purchase needed. Edit or remove an existing record for the same host first. Never guess the Value.
- Host/Name: "@" for root (blank on Porkbun; blank or "@" on Squarespace), "www" for www. Leave TTL at default unless told. Repeat for every record.
- GoDaddy: "Domain Portfolio" > "Domain Settings" > "DNS" > "Add New Record". Works only if GoDaddy manages DNS.
- Namecheap: "Domain List" > "Manage" > "Advanced DNS" > "Host Records" > "Add New Record", then the save checkmark. No Host Records means custom nameservers, so add records where they point.
- Squarespace Domains: "Domains" dashboard > domain > "DNS" > "Custom records".
- Cloudflare: domain > "DNS" > "Records" > "Add record", using Content/Target. If it won't verify, set the record to "DNS only".
- Network Solutions: "Domains" > domain > "Advanced Tools" > "Manage" beside "Advanced DNS Records" > "+Add Record". For A records pick "@", "www" or another host, and use "Points to". It may need its own nameservers.
- Porkbun: "Domain Management" > "DNS" > "Add Record", using "Answer", "Value" or "IPv4 Address". CNAME Host can't be blank.
- When verified, the domain shows as connected and opens the site once a publish has succeeded; otherwise visitors see a 404.
- Not connecting: check where DNS is managed, exact records, an old same-host record, and time. Contact support if unsure where DNS is managed, the registrar won't save, it's unverified after 24 hours, or you see an unclear error. Send the domain name plus screenshots of the app's records and your registrar's records.

### Manage Your Personal Account {slug: account-settings}
Get here: Click your workspace name in the top-left corner, click "Settings", then click "Profile" in the left menu under "Account".

- Personal settings follow you across all workspaces. On older workspace pages, click a setting's own save or update button after each change.
- "Account": "Profile", "Notifications", "Appearance", "Security". "Your calendar": "Email & Calendar", "Availability", "Conferencing".

**Profile**
- Name: "Your name", then "Save changes" on the bottom bar.
- Email: "Update your email", type "New email", click "Send confirmation". Click the link in your current inbox, then the link in the new inbox. Links last about 10 minutes; if expired, resubmit. Keep logging in with the old email until both steps finish.
- Photo: "Profile picture" > "Upload" (PNG or JPG), crop, save. "Remove" deletes it.

**Appearance**: "Light", "Dark", "System". Saves immediately.

**Security**
- Password: enter current and new, "Save changes". New password needs 12+ characters (under 73), upper and lowercase, one number. "Email me a link" if forgotten. Other devices are signed out. Social-login users see "Set a password" > "Set password" (emailed link).
- Two-step sign in (needs a password): "Set up", enter password, "Continue", scan the code, type the 6-digit code, "Turn on". Save backup codes (each works once, not shown again), "Done". "Turn off…" needs your password.
- Sign-in methods: "Email and password" shows Active. "Google": "Connect" or "Disconnect…". You can't disconnect it if it's your only way in.
- "Active sessions": click a row's sign-out button, or "Sign out of other sessions…".

**Availability**
- Timezone saves immediately.
- "Buffer times": "Before each meeting", "After each meeting": No buffer, 5, 15 or 30 minutes. Saves immediately.
- Working hours: turn a day on, set times, "+" adds blocks, "Save changes". A day turned on without times defaults to 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Copy icon > tick days > "Copy to … days" > "Save changes".
- "Booking link": must start with https://, "Save changes". The AI SDR includes it.

**Email & Calendar**
- "Connected accounts": "Connect Google", "Connect Outlook" or "Connect account". Up to 5. Disconnecting removes it from all workspaces.
- Calendar (saves immediately): "Put new meetings on", "Busy times come from", "Show my event names to my team" (off shows "External Event"; Acquisity meetings always show). Google holiday calendars for the US, Canada and Spain block public holidays; observances stay bookable; UK, Australian and other-language calendars block nothing.
- Email sync: per-workspace switch under "Email" for Gmail; imports last 90 days, never moves emails. Outlook shows status only.
- "Add new people from email" and "Track email opens and clicks": Admin or Owner only. Choices: "Only people already in your CRM" or "Also add people you email"; "Review" for pending addresses.
- "Email signature": "Add signature"/"Edit", "Use workspace template", "Save changes". Admins and Owners edit "Workspace signature template".

**Conferencing**: "Meeting link type": "Your personal link" (paste, "Save") or "Zoom" > "Connect Zoom".

**Delete account**: permanent. Owners must add another owner or delete the workspace first. "Profile" > "Danger zone" > "Delete account", type email, confirm. Your sales calls, reports, appointments, chats and connected accounts are deleted. Shared CRM records stay. Cold email setup person: campaigns and leads are deleted.

**Troubleshooting**: Email change not working: finish both links, check spam, resubmit if expired. Calendar missing: connect it in "Email & Calendar".
